target.name: Ventilation equipment, Avent E 97, at plant

strategy.label: transcription drafted from the report excerpt by the LLM pipeline (reverse-bafu draft)
strategy.note: basis: Tabelle 10.20 'Herstellung, Lueftungsgeraete, dezentral, ab Werk', 3rd value column 'Lueftungsgeraet, Avent E 97, ab Werk' [RER], per 1 unit; allocation: none stated. Review every derivation; unreviewed entries have reviewed_by = null.

evidence.source: 2007 - LCI comfort ventilation in dwellings - Haessig.pdf

gaps_reported_by_model: The Avent E 97 column is empty for chromium steel, PVC, HIPS, EPDM rubber, expanded polystyrene board, injection moulding, pipe extrusion and the polystyrene-waste incineration lines - those belong to the other devices.
The disposal of the device is a separate dataset (Tabelle 10.21).
A few rows of the lower half of the table lost their name in the text extraction; they carry no value in the Avent column, so nothing is lost for this dataset.
